Who we are

Healthcare, connected end to end

Octave Health-Tech Services Private Limited brings hospitals, doctors, diagnostic centres, finance partners and home-care teams onto one platform, so patients get the right care faster and pay for it more easily.

Mission

Make quality care easy to reach

For patients in India and abroad, at every stage of treatment.

Vision

One trusted health partner

Treatment, funding and recovery coordinated under a single roof.

Approach

Technology with a human touch

Digital processes for speed, dedicated coordinators for every case.

Service 02 · Healthcare Finance

A simple, fast process

Submits Invoice

02

Quick Approval

03

04

06

Repayment

Patient repays the NBFC on receipt from insurance
